name: caller-principal-python-session-stop-refuses-an-absent-principal
description: KTD12 -- the require-class half on Python. session-stop releases every grant the named session holds. The preflight CLAIMS session A, so A is bound; a request naming A without A's principal is then refused: HTTP 400 naming the header, never a hold (KTD9). (A session nobody claimed -- an older client's -- is admitted instead: fixture 15 and warn_mode/05.) Twin of the Node row that admits the SAME request (04). Enforcement is accident-resistance under the same-OS-user cooperative trust model, not caller separation: on the hook surface the principal is stored under .coherence/.

body.error: missing Coherence-Caller-Principal header: this route requires the caller principal that POST /principal/claim bound to the session_id it names (caller_principal_absent)
